about: Prism Deck Game Link demo: a fictional Counter-Strike 2 match as the Game State Integration posts a live player receives, in order, with their receive times (atMs). Copied from prism-deck/test/fixtures/gamelink/cs2 (real CS2 shapes, invented values). Steam ids are out-of-range fictional ids, names are invented, the auth token is the fixtures' example token. Frames marked synth were added or edited for the demo: a final-round ACE.

frames.note: Main menu. Only provider + a 3-field player. No map/round.
Loading into a match: map only, player gone (previously.player = true), no 'added' for map.
Warmup: map.phase warmup, no round node, money 16000. Player re-appears without an 'added' entry.
Round 7 freezetime (map.round = 6 rounds completed). Shown as a full-state post (e.g. first post after the listener restarted mid-match), so no deltas.
Bought M4A1-S (2900) + kevlar & helmet (1000). Money and equip_value move; weapon_2 added.
Bought defuse kit (400) + flashbang (200). state.defusekit appears only once owned.
Freezetime over: round.phase live (previously.round.phase = freezetime). Round clock starts (1:55).
Took 27 damage (armor 100 -> 91).
flashed = 255 (100% white).
flashed = 177 (69% white).
flashed = 113 (44% white).
flashed = 64 (25% white).
flashed = 28 (11% white).
flashed = 7 (3% white).
flashed = 0 (0% white).
Kill: round_kills 0 -> 1, kill reward +300 arrives at once, match_stats.kills +1, score +2, clip 20 -> 13.
Headshot kill: round_kills 2 and round_killhs 1 in the same post (double kill). Clip 4/20 = low ammo.
Reload pressed: state reloading, clip unchanged (4).
Magazine swapped: clip 20, reserve 3 -> 2 magazines (remaining 4 rounds discarded, 2026-03-18 rules). State is still 'reloading' for one more post.
Back to active.
Bomb planted: added.round.bomb = true. The ONLY fuse signal in live play: start a local 40 s clock at receipt. Valve delays this signal for players on a team, so the clock runs late (see cs2-gsi.md).
Defusing with a kit (5 s). Live play exposes NO defuse state; this is just a heartbeat (no deltas).
Round over: bomb defused, win_team CT, map.round 6 -> 7, CT score 5, round_wins['7'] added, MVP +1, score +3 for the defuse, money +3500 team win +300 defuse bonus.
Round 8 freezetime: round.bomb and win_team removed (previously shows old values), health back to 100, round_kills reset.
Round 8 live.
Death: health 0, armor 0, helmet false, defusekit key removed, weapons {} (previously lists every lost weapon in full), deaths +1, equip_value unchanged. Still our own steamid.
Spectating: player.steamid != provider.steamid. All player fields are the TEAMMATE's. previously holds OUR old values (steamid, name, slot, state...).
Observed teammate flashed (240). Self-only Game Link must ignore this.
Round lost (win_team T) while spectating; last teammate died.
Player node gone at round end (previously.player = true).
Halftime: the post that ends round 12 already says map.phase intermission (round.phase over). Scores are side-labelled: we are CT with 8.
Round 13 freezetime: team flipped CT -> T AND the side scores swapped (team_t is now our 8), money 800.
Round 23 just won (T 12 : CT 11). Full-state post after a time jump.
Round 24 freezetime, T 12 : CT 11: we (T) are on match point (13 wins in MR12). Derived, not a field. Kept the AK (17/30, 2 mags); money +3250 win reward.
Round 24 live.
Final round: first kill (AK-47). round_kills 0 -> 1, +$300.
Second kill, a headshot: round_kills 2, round_killhs 1 (a double).
Third kill: round_kills 3 (a triple). Clip 3/30 = low ammo.
Reload pressed: state reloading.
Magazine in: clip 30, reserve 2 -> 1, back to active.
Fourth kill, a headshot: round_kills 4, round_killhs 2 (a quad).

Gameover straight from live (no separate "over" post): the fifth kill of the round (an ACE) ends round 24. map.phase gameover, round.phase FREEZETIME with win_team T, T 13 : CT 11. We (T) won the match.
Left the match: map and round removed (previously.map/round = true), player back to 3 fields.
